Country/Region of Origin: Afghanistan
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: The game evolved from traditional card games in the region and is the most popular social game in Afghanistan.
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included

Standard 52-card deck
Score sheet (optional)
Table space

Cards per Player: 13 each (all at once)
Dealing Pattern: Counterclockwise
Player to dealer's left cuts before the deal. Cards shuffled only before first deal; later dealers may cut but not shuffle.
